about.sectionTitle: A little about who I am
description: I am a Full Stack Engineer with over 5 years of experience building scalable web applications and developer tools. I enjoy working across the entire stack — from designing robust backend systems to crafting pixel-perfect user interfaces.

I am deeply passionate about open source, clean architecture, and writing code that other developers love to work with. When I am not coding I am probably contributing to a side project or exploring new technologies.

skills.sectionTitle: What I bring to the table

items.description: A full stack web app that generates and deploys personal portfolio sites to GitHub Pages in minutes. Supports dynamic styles and runtime data loading via JSON, making each portfolio unique.
A real time collaborative coding platform with built-in video chat and code execution support. Supports 10+ programming languages and allows teams to code together with zero setup.
A personal finance tracker that uses ML to categorize expenses and predict monthly spending. Integrated with major banks via Plaid API with support for multi-currency accounts.
A developer CLI tool for searching, filtering and managing Elasticsearch indices from the terminal. Used by 500+ developers with 1000+ GitHub stars.
